title: A hexanuclear cerium oxo cluster stabilized by furoate: Synthesis, structure, and remarkable ability to scavenge hydroxyl radicals

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.compound_name: ammonium hexanuclear cerium(IV) oxo cluster with furoate, nitrate and aqua ligands

synthesis.procedure: In a 6 mL glass vial containing 0.245 g ammonium cerium(IV) nitrate and 0.263 g 2-furoic acid (HFA), acetonitrile and deionized water were added, followed by dropwise addition of 0.21 g N-methyldiethanolamine to give a solution of pH ≈ 2.7. The vial was sealed with a PTFE film and left standing at room temperature to afford orange-red block crystals of compound 1 (yield ca. 39% based on Ce).
synthesis.vessel_or_method: 6 mL glass vial sealed with PTFE film; solution method, standing crystallization
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Orange-red block crystals of 1 formed upon standing at room temperature.

properties.summary: Compound 1 shows a broad UV–Vis absorption assigned to O→Ce(IV) charge-transfer and a Tauc-derived direct bandgap of about 2.44 eV. In a Fenton/methyl-violet assay monitored at 584 nm, solutions of 1 scavenge ·OH with efficiency rising from 8.32% to 91.06% as the added volume increases from 50 to 2000 µL (52.06% at a comparable cluster concentration).

measurements.name: optical bandgap (Tauc, direct)
measurements.conditions: Tauc plot of UV–Vis absorption (Fig. 5 inset)

measurements.name: ·OH scavenging efficiency (UV–Vis at 584 nm)
measurements.conditions: Fenton assay with methyl violet indicator; 50–2000 µL of ~0.09 mmol·L−1 compound 1 in MeCN/H2O (3:1 v/v)

source_locations.location: abstract; crystal structure discussion of [Ce6O4(OH)4]12+ core
